name: codex-delegate
description: Codex Delegate classifies unresolved dependencies and places evidence, bounded execution, judgment-coupled execution, difficult technical investigation, and independent review on the smallest useful Codex compute graph.

interface.shortDescription: Capability-aware adaptive delegation with independent final review.
interface.longDescription: Codex Delegate keeps the current session in control and routes by unresolved responsibility rather than a model ladder. Luna Max handles reusable evidence and standardized bounded execution, Sol High supplies judgment-coupled execution or bounded judgment when the main session does not already cover that capability, Terra XHigh investigates only narrow difficult technical uncertainty after semantics stabilize, and a fresh Sol Advisor provides independent artifact-bound review only when the deliverable's material consequences require it.
defaultPrompt: Use /codex-delegate to classify the unresolved dependencies and choose the smallest useful compute graph.
Use /codex-delegate to implement this change with capability-aware routing, evidence reuse, and deterministic verification.
Use /codex-delegate to review this task and apply fresh independent Sol review only when the final artifact requires it.
